title: ID0483551-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / P0 170001088] Cable management system issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Cable management system keeps failing. This system already has been replaced under warranty in the past, but it is broken again now. In april 2025 Siemens promised to replace all cable
management systems for better versions, but this hasn't been executed as of now. As discussed with Daan Borsje (Siemens), he will handle this ticket.
